create.name: Yoga Maastricht
create.bio:
Yoga Maastricht is an Iyengar studio on the Volksplein in Maastricht, opened in 2007 by Melanie Tillema after she moved to the city. She has practised the method since 1996, completed the three-year Iyengar teacher training in Amsterdam, and now mentors trainee teachers for the Dutch Iyengar association. She leads a regular team of certified teachers, among them Marianne Defesche, who first travelled to India in 1976 and brings meditation and philosophy into her classes, and teachers trained in Riga and Amsterdam.

The studio, a large wood-floored hall with rope walls and timber beams, runs more than twenty classes a week across six levels, from complete beginners to long-standing practitioners, with some mixed-level classes taught in English and others available online. Students can start at any time with a low-cost trial lesson. Beyond the timetable there is a monthly pranayama class and an introductory pranayama course, monthly three-hour Sunday sessions that explore a theme in depth and finish with soup, and weekend workshops with visiting senior Iyengar teachers from abroad. The studio also keeps a small library of articles and videos on its site and sells props through its own shop.

courses.title: Vast abonnement
courses.description: Monthly to yearly memberships for one or two classes a week, or unlimited classes, with class cards for extra sessions and single drop-in rates on the same page. A one-off registration fee applies.
courses.price: 1 x per week per maand > € 58,-; onbeperkt per maand > €105,00

courses.title: Maandelijkse pranayamales
courses.description: A 90-minute breathing practice on one Sunday morning a month with Marianne Defesche, for students who already know the basics of pranayama. It can be joined in the studio or online, and questions from home practice can be sent in beforehand.
courses.price: € 16 voor leden met actief abonnement; overige deelnemers €18,50

courses.title: Introductiecursus pranayama
courses.description: A six-week Sunday morning course introducing Iyengar pranayama, taught in Dutch by Marianne Defesche for students with at least a year of posture practice. Planned for January and February 2027, subject to confirmation.

courses.title: Yoga & soep
courses.description: A monthly three-hour Sunday session with Melanie Tillema that works through a different theme each time, for students with at least a year of Iyengar practice, followed by a bowl of soup.
courses.price: €39,50 voor leden met een actief abonnement; niet leden €45,00

courses.title: Glenn Ceresoli komt naar Maastricht!
courses.description: A three-day weekend workshop, taught in English, with the Australian senior Iyengar teacher Glenn Ceresoli, for students with over a year of practice who are steady in headstand and shoulderstand. One or two days can be booked if places remain.
